summary.goal: One continuous scientific chain from kernel through K0--K12 and domain theorems to observables, datasets, held-out replay, falsifiers, and a global verdict.

governance.broadening_freeze_rule: No new domains, external claims, or narrative universes may enter the scientific canon until Phase 1 stabilizes and the physics theorem packet locks.
governance.ticket_admissibility_rule: Every scientific task must map to exactly one closure-bundle artifact or one hostile-review dossier.

campaigns.goal: Either prove K11 and K12 necessary beyond K10 or demote them and rebuild the dependency graph.
Build one unified science atlas and prove cross-domain integrability.

governance.anti_cycle_rule: A method class may not be repeated unless a new formal premise, new dataset family, or new observable family enters the claim.

prioritization_formula: (closure impact x dependency centrality x expected information gain) / (compute cost + data cost + measurement cost + editorial cost)

method_ladder.entry_rule: Use when a claim lacks an exact theorem target, exact dependency list, or exact source text.
method_ladder.advance_condition: The claim is reduced to an exact theorem packet or exact falsifiable subclaim.
method_ladder.anti_cycle_condition: May not be repeated unless a new source block, new theorem family, or newly scoped parent claim is introduced.

method_ladder.entry_rule: Use when source extraction alone does not close the theorem-native route.
method_ladder.advance_condition: A new derivation binds the claim back to kernel operators and K-level doctrine without hidden auxiliary hypotheses.
method_ladder.anti_cycle_condition: May not be repeated unless a new formal premise or a new decomposition of the claim space appears.

method_ladder.entry_rule: Use when the claim is too wide, rubberized, or under-specified to admit a lawful parameter law.
method_ladder.advance_condition: The claim is replaced by narrower child claims with explicit parent relations and non-degenerate parameter laws.
method_ladder.anti_cycle_condition: May not be repeated unless a new observable family or a new admissible regime is declared before replay.

method_ladder.entry_rule: Use only after theorem target, parameter law, and held-out policy are already fixed.
method_ladder.advance_condition: A new primary-data or institute-run route closes a genuinely missing observable family without widening scope.
method_ladder.anti_cycle_condition: May not be repeated unless the new route adds a previously unavailable observable family or a nonoverlapping held-out family.

method_ladder.entry_rule: Use when the claim survives internal closure steps and must now face simpler same-claim-class competitors.
method_ladder.advance_condition: No simpler comparator explains the same claim class better under the declared cost and evidence bar.
method_ladder.anti_cycle_condition: May not be repeated unless a new comparator family or a new cost-normalized metric is introduced.

phase_registry.objective: Stabilize the load-bearing theorem spine, hostile-review dossiers, and mathematics anchor before outward theoremization.
phase_registry.exit_criterion: Closed core survives hostile review, excluded-lift leakage is blocked, and the mathematics anchor is maintained as theorem-native.

phase_registry.objective: Turn each blocked domain into an exact theorem-native research target before replay or measurement escalation.
phase_registry.exit_criterion: Every blocked domain owns an exact theorem packet, parameter-law packet, observable map, and locked held-out policy.

phase_registry.objective: Close the first domain theorem-native route over bounded physical benchmark families.
phase_registry.exit_criterion: Physics theorem packet, parameter law, observable route, and held-out replay all pass under the declared promotion bar.

phase_registry.objective: Close chemistry as the next source-near organizational bridge after physics.
phase_registry.exit_criterion: Chemistry theorem packet survives held-out compound or reaction rotation without hidden fit freedom.

phase_registry.objective: Close bounded biological state-transition and response-signature science without overclaiming general biology.
phase_registry.exit_criterion: Biological theorem-native packets survive cross-dataset held-out tests and do not rest on a single dataset family.

phase_registry.objective: Close K8 systems projection packets strictly on measurable macro-process trajectories and regime shifts.
phase_registry.exit_criterion: Systems turning-point and trajectory claims survive held-out interval replay with no out-of-band behavior.

phase_registry.objective: Build one unified atlas and integrability suite across closed domains.
phase_registry.exit_criterion: Shared operators, invariants, and observables remain globally noncontradictory and no global falsifier survives.

phase_registry.objective: Run controlled expansion after first global PASS without mixing frontier work with closed canon.
phase_registry.exit_criterion: New claims are promoted only through the same ladder and the atlas continues to compress ignorance rather than inflate rhetoric.

domain_priority_board.minimum_theorem_native_claim: Maintain the exact-question theorem-native anchor and expand the counterexample search without broadening scope by rhetoric alone.
domain_priority_board.parameter_law_target: Strengthen exact terminalization and minimal-denominator control on the current exact-question corpus.
domain_priority_board.parallelism_note: Runs continuously as the formal anchor for all later domains.

domain_priority_board.minimum_theorem_native_claim: Prove a bounded theorem-native physics packet for K1/K2 contradiction-load and stabilization-margin operators over constants, spectral lines, and transport residual families.
domain_priority_board.parameter_law_target: Derive explicit parameter laws for bounded physical families and eliminate pure fitted-envelope interpretations.
domain_priority_board.parallelism_note: Primary first closure lane; no later domain should outrun it.

domain_priority_board.minimum_theorem_native_claim: Prove a bounded theorem-native chemistry packet for thermochemical, spectroscopic, and kinetic observable families.
domain_priority_board.parameter_law_target: Derive composition-sensitive thermochemical and kinetic parameter laws with explicit admissible regimes and no hidden fit freedom.
domain_priority_board.parallelism_note: Next formal lane after physics; some data preparation may run earlier, but promotion waits for the physics shell to lock.

domain_priority_board.minimum_theorem_native_claim: Prove bounded theorem-native biological packets for expression-signature, state-transition-order, and response-onset lanes.
domain_priority_board.parameter_law_target: Derive state-transition and response-signature parameter laws that survive cross-dataset tests.
domain_priority_board.parallelism_note: Formal order precedes systems, but the high measurement cost makes it a slower lane.

domain_priority_board.minimum_theorem_native_claim: Prove a bounded theorem-native systems packet for measurable macro-process trajectories and regime-shift signatures only.
domain_priority_board.parameter_law_target: Derive change-point and throughput parameter laws without discretionary knobs.
domain_priority_board.parallelism_note: Cheaper empirical prep than biology is allowed, but final unification waits for the biological formal route.
